definition: Illegally printed biomedical tissue — typically bone, cartilage, or organ lining — produced by unlicensed Helix Biosystems knockoff printers. Cheaper than certified geneware but prone to immune rejection, structural failure, and Diaspora-invisible provenance.
origin: Street medical jargon, used by street docs and low-tier patients who can't afford certified biosystems
usage: Street docs, Shelf clinics, desperate Tier 2 patients, black-market surgeons
example: The knee held for eight months before the ghost cartilage started delaminating — good run, honestly, for what he paid.
